Before you install

  • Installs side-by-side with upstream Wisp: this fork uses its own package ID (de.rtard.wisp, launcher name "Wisp Fork"), so both can stay installed. Restore and verify your recovery phrase / nsec inside Wisp Fork before uninstalling the upstream app.
  • Verify the APK checksum against SHA256SUMS, or check the signing certificate fingerprint above in your installer.
  • This is an independent fork build. It is not published or endorsed by the upstream author.

What changed in this fork

  • No Google sign-in + Amber support: Removed "Continue with Google" and Google Drive backup — sign in with your Nostr key or external signer app (Amber).
  • Stronger private messages: Blocks spoofed DMs and stops automatic media downloads in DMs so strangers can't see your IP address.
  • Reliable, safer zaps: Fixed zaps failing with popular Lightning providers and verifies invoices before your wallet pays them.
  • Safer wallet recovery: Catches typos and weird copy-paste spaces in recovery phrases instead of letting invalid ones slip through.
  • Private crash reports: Strips keys and wallet secrets from crash logs automatically.
